title: TWILIGHT in Concert
seo_title: TWILIGHT in Concert at Hammons Hall, Springfield MO
description: TWILIGHT in Concert is a live-to-film event where the original Twilight film plays on a full-size cinema screen while a 12-piece ensemble of rock and orchestral musicians performs the score live, with over a thousand candles lighting the stage. It is designed for devoted Twilight fans and newcomers alike. It takes place Wednesday, March 10, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts

organizer.name: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
